integrity: Analytical proof supplied. Numerical verification is reproducible but is not proof of infinite cases. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Assumes directly homothetic parallel n-gonal bases with 0<t<1, uniformly random orthogonal viewing directions, and known base for aspect identification; no finite-sample error theorem; historical priority provisional.
title: Two-atom random silhouette law for homothetic polygonal frusta
